Basic concepts, legislation in our country and in the world, economic concepts of the real estate market, its determinants and commodities, residential and commercial sector. (allowance 2/2)

Ownership of immovable property and its changes (ownership, co-ownership, joint property of spouses, procedure for change of ownership, contractual relations, escrow, tax nexus, certificate of energy performance of the building), real estate cadastre. (allowance 2/2)
Use of real estate (rent, sublease, apartment rental, services). Real rights to another's property (encumbrances, lien, right of construction, right of pre-emption). (allowance 2/2)
The activity of a real estate agency (types of real estate agencies, professional associations, work procedures, recruitment, sales, communication, contractual relations). (allowance 2/2)

Tax aspects of the real estate business (personal income tax, corporate income tax, value added tax, acquisition tax, property tax). Association of unit owners, cooperative ownership, housing association. (allowance 2/2)

Auctions, foreclosures, real estate software, real estate management, spatial planning, building authority. Geometric plans, engineering networks in connection with transfers of real estate. (allowance 2/2)
Real estate financing (mortgage loan, insurance), investing in real estate, types of investors, development projects. (allowance 2/2)
An introduction to real estate valuation. (allowance 2/2)
Performance of property appraisers and forensic experts in the field of real estate valuation. (allowance 2/2)
Real estate valuation theory. (allowance 2/2)
Basis for valuation. (allowance 2/2)
Appraisal of building plots, agricultural plots. (allowance 2/2)
Appraisal of buildings and halls, family houses, holiday cottages and holiday houses, garages, outdoor improvements, wells, units. (allowance 2/2)
Valuation of holiday cottages, gardening cottages, outbuildings and other structures. (allowance 2/2)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the subject is to familiarize the students with the issue of ownership and use of immovable property, with legislation and various aspects of the real estate trade. Students will acquire theoretical knowledge about the valuation of real estate, about the performance of property appraisers and forensic experts in the field of real estate valuation.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Basic concepts, legislation in our country and in the world, economic concepts of the real estate market, its determinants and commodities, residential and commercial sector. (allowance 2/2)2.Ownership of immovable property and its changes (ownership, co-ownership, joint property of spouses, procedure for change of ownership, contractual relations, escrow, tax nexus, certificate of energy performance of the building), real estate cadastre. (allowance 2/2)3.Use of real estate (rent, sublease, apartment rental, services). Real rights to another's property (encumbrances, lien, right of construction, right of pre-emption). (allowance 2/2)4.The activity of a real estate agency (types of real estate agencies, professional associations, work procedures, recruitment, sales, communication, contractual relations). (allowance 2/2)5.Tax aspects of the real estate business (personal income tax, corporate income tax, value added tax, acquisition tax, property tax). Association of unit owners, cooperative ownership, housing association. (allowance 2/2)6.Auctions, foreclosures, real estate software, real estate management, spatial planning, building authority. Geometric plans, engineering networks in connection with transfers of real estate. (allowance 2/2)7.Real estate financing (mortgage loan, insurance), investing in real estate, types of investors, development projects. (allowance 2/2)8.An introduction to real estate valuation. (allowance 2/2)9.Performance of property appraisers and forensic experts in the field of real estate valuation. (allowance 2/2)10.Real estate valuation theory. (allowance 2/2)11.Basis for valuation. (allowance 2/2)12.Appraisal of building plots, agricultural plots. (allowance 2/2)13.Appraisal of buildings and halls, family houses, holiday cottages and holiday houses, garages, outdoor improvements, wells, units. (allowance 2/2)14.Valuation of holiday cottages, gardening cottages, outbuildings and other structures. (allowance 2/2)
